_note: Words for the calendar page, the event window and reminders. Edit the wording here. {name}, {n} and {when} are filled in by the app.
title: Calendar
deleteCalendarConfirm: Delete the calendar "{name}" and every event in it? This can't be undone.
downloadHint: Saves all your calendars as one file (.ics) to keep as a copy, or to add to Apple Calendar, Outlook or Google Calendar.
shareIntro: Choose who on your team can see this calendar, and how much. Private events always show as Busy.
shareEveryoneHint: Choose Can edit to make this a team calendar everyone can add to.
shareNobody: Nobody else on your team uses a different mailbox yet. Once an admin adds people on the People page, you can share this calendar with them.
sharedCalNote: This is {owner}'s calendar. Guests and reminders can only be added in your own calendars.
sharedReadOnly: This is in {owner}'s calendar. You can see it but not change it.
sharedBusy: {owner} shares only when they're busy, not what the event is.
sharedGuests: This event has guests, so only {owner}'s own people can change it.
feedIntro: Make a private link to see this calendar in Apple Calendar, Outlook or Google Calendar on your phone or computer. It's read only. Apple Calendar and Outlook check for changes about every hour; Google Calendar can take up to a day.
feedWarning: Anyone with this link can see the calendar, so only put it in apps you use. If it ends up somewhere it shouldn't, make a new link and the old one stops working.
feedFailed: That didn't work. Please try again.
outsideAdd: Add a calendar from a link
outsideTitle: Add a calendar from a link
outsideIntro: Show a calendar from another website alongside your own, such as bank holidays, a club's fixtures or a colleague's Google or Outlook calendar shared as a link. It's read only, and we bring it up to date every few hours.
outsideReadOnly: This is from "{name}", a calendar from another website, so it can't be changed here.
outsideRemoveConfirm: Remove "{name}" from your calendars? You can add it again from its link at any time.
importIntro: Bring events in from Google Calendar, Outlook or Apple Calendar. Export your calendar there as an .ics file, then choose it here. The events become your own, so you can change them. Nobody is emailed.
importDoneSkipped: Added {added} events. {skipped} were already in your calendar.
importHowTo: Where to find the file: in Google Calendar, go to Settings > Import and export > Export, then open the .zip it downloads. In Outlook, save the calendar as an iCalendar file. In Apple Calendar, choose File > Export.
notesPlaceholder: Add notes, an agenda or links
remindersHint: Reminders appear on every device where you've switched on notifications in Settings.
privateHint: Others who use this mailbox, and people you share the calendar with, only see that you're busy, not what the event is.
privateShared: Private: others see this as Busy
someoneElsesPrivate: This is {name}'s private event, so only they can see or change it.
failed: That didn't save. Please try again.
loadFailed: The calendar couldn't load. Please try again.
empty: Nothing on. Click or drag on the calendar to add an event.
emptyPhone: Nothing on. Press New event to add one.
guestsHint: Each guest is emailed an invite they can answer from Outlook, Gmail, Apple Mail or Mail App.
emailGuestsHint: New guests get an invite, everyone else hears about changes, and anyone you remove is told they're off the list.
invitedNote: You were invited to this. Changes you make here only change your own calendar.
meetingPlaceholder: Paste a Teams, Zoom or Google Meet link
addJitsiHint: Makes a free Jitsi Meet link. The first person to join may be asked to sign in with Google, GitHub or Facebook.
badMeeting: That doesn't look like a web link. It should start with https://
guestsEmailed: Event saved. Guests have been emailed.
guestsCancelled: Event deleted. Guests have been told it's cancelled.
notEmailed: Event saved, but guests weren't emailed: {problem}

invite.title: Invitation

answered.accepted: You're going. It's in your calendar.
answered.tentative: You might go. It's in your calendar as Maybe.

invite.outdated: There's a newer version of this invite. Your calendar has the latest one.
invite.oneDate: A change to one date of a repeating event
invite.notSent: Saved in your calendar, but your answer wasn't sent: {problem}
invite.failed: That didn't work. Please try again.
